content_sections.title: Present simple
content_sections.body_text: Use the present simple for facts and repeated actions: I live in Hanoi. She studies English every day. Say each word clearly.

content_sections.title: Personal information
content_sections.body_text: Introduce yourself with short true sentences. Listen for the sounds at the ends of live and studies.
